The chart title is 'DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Comparison', indicating only the 14B model scale is represented, not both 7B and 14B.

errors.text_span: its tick intervals are spaced by 10%

The chart shows two types of bars as defined by the legend ('Vanilla CoT' and 'TLDR (Ours)'), which are arranged in four groups of two. There are not three types of bars.

errors.text_span: and a light green bar represents the same method with a 14B model scale

errors.text_span: whereas the bar for MATH500 with TLDR (Ours) shows an accuracy of 79.6%

errors.text_span: and TLDR (Ours) with an accuracy of 79.6%
errors.evidence: The value 79.6% corresponds to the 'Vanilla CoT' bar for the 'AMC' dataset, not the 'TLDR (Ours)' bar.
The description fails to mention that the bars are grouped in pairs for each dataset category, a fundamental structural aspect of the chart.
The description completely omits the percentage annotations (e.g., '-1.6%', '+0.2%') shown above the 'TLDR (Ours)' bars, which are a key visual element for comparison.
